from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action or claim title explicitly stated in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case (e.g., 民事，刑事，行政)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
